$interpretive_tension.description: Canon V2 §15 lists 'unbreakable_shield.json' as a SEPARATE entity, implying a discrete object. Canon V2 §8.2 calls it 'Unbreakable Shield (vertical plasma pillar discharge)'. Canon V2 §11 item 4 confirms 'Lyre's shield vents vertical white/cyan plasma'. However, COMMANDER_LYRE_VISUAL_SPEC_CLEAN_V0_1.md §7 explicitly supersedes the physical interpretation: 'the barrier is a force-field system generated by the Lyre weapon, not a carried object.' COMMANDER_LYRE_CHARACTER_BRIEF_V0_1.md §7 echoes this.
